C Cin VIN1 n1
L Lg n1 n2
NMOS M1 n3 n2 n4 VSS
L Ls n4 VSS
L Ld VDD n3
C Ct1 n3 n5

rationale: The proposed topology improves the binding constraints—specifically S21 and Idd—by adding a source inductor (Ls) to enhance output matching and reduce current draw through improved impedance transformation, while preserving stability and noise performance. The inductor tunes the output impedance to better match 50Ω, boosting S21 beyond the 10 dB threshold, and reduces the DC current by lowering the effective load seen by the transistor, thereby alleviating the Idd excess. The differential nature remains single-ended, and the topology stays within device budget and inductor limits.
